interpretation:
Complete command diversity using a calibrated, versioned native stream encoder.

Requires independently completed replay audits. This encoder never substitutes
for simulation re-auditing and does not establish statistical independence.
 Canonical format preserves all within-hero/tick command order while normalizing cross-hero serialization. Every original action remains represented. Distinct seeds, bytes or command sets do not imply independent samples.
